description: Header file declaring functions for extracting and processing various types of values, labels, files, directories, and libraries in a build system context.

methods.name: ExtractListOfStringValues
methods.description: Extracts a list of string values from a given Value object.

methods.name: ExtractListOfRelativeFiles
methods.description: Finds a list of source files relative to a current directory.

methods.name: ExtractListOfLibs
methods.description: Extracts a list of libraries, treating paths with '/' as source paths.

methods.name: ExtractListOfRelativeDirs
methods.description: Finds source directories relative to a current directory.

methods.name: ExtractListOfLabels
methods.description: Extracts labels and their origins into a vector.

methods.name: ExtractListOfUniqueLabels
methods.description: Extracts unique labels, handling duplicates and malformed labels.

methods.name: ExtractRelativeFile
methods.description: Extracts a single source file relative to a current directory.

methods.name: ExtractListOfLabelPatterns
methods.description: Extracts label patterns into a vector.

methods.name: ExtractListOfExterns
methods.description: Extracts external references as pairs of strings and LibFile objects.
